painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [1/x]
I figured it'd be fun to share the whole process that goes into making a painting a custom scene. could be useful to some, and entertaining to others :)
👩‍🦱 ~ EVE & ADAM ~ 🧔‍♂️
as you all know, I'm a deeply religious person 🛐 so..
the scene: we're in the garden of eden. adam is eating apples from the forbidden tree, because of course he is. eve is having none of his shit, grabs an unfortunate unsuspecting nearby serpent, and is about to whip the shit out of adam. 🐍
#painting

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [2/x]
so, we're gonna need reference photos. I want eve to be in the process of swinging the serpent around; so then I figured a baseball batter would be a good fit.
so wading through the AI slop, I found this actual photo that has a nice pose and good lighting.

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [3/x]
I want adam to be in a protective stance, while also holding a forbidden apple, and all this, seen from the side/back. also, the lighting has to come from the same side as the batter. so all and all, it's pretty hard to find a proper reference pic for this, so I am posing for this one myself.
took about 20 pics with slightly different in stances etc., and decided on this one. (the right hand is going to hold the apple)

The last time I was out here, you could see 27 miles across northwest Alabama.
You getting tired of the view?
No.
The trouble is that the birds keep on flying into the glass because they can't see it and break their wings.
Well, why don't you just throw an old fishnet over the window?
That way you'd have your view and your birds.
Well, I just guess and calculate.
I never thought of it.
You know, I swear, if a fly was to bust his leg, he'd come running with a splint.

And that might actually be the play because things like UCT are smarter about traversing a tree with a budget and splitting how deep vs broad you go

Welp think I'm going to implement UCT because my game's just Go now this is going to be a journey

source_doc:
My brother in He-Who-Shall-Not-Be-Named, what you are describing is a consequence of _misogyny_, not "misandry."

I desperately need men to realize that just because it's directed at them and an actual serious problem doesn't mean it is "misandry."
Just saw someone describe being discriminated against _for being considered effeminate_ as "misandry" and I just.

It's not that you aren't experiencing something real. You very well may be. But it isn't "misandry." Because "misandry" doesn't exist.
Yes, this applies to trans men as well. "Transmisandry" _also_ isn't a thing and just contributes to anti-feminist narratives. It treats itself as a mirror of transmisogyny, but transmisogyny is _intersective_: we experience transphobia _and_ we experience misogyny _and_ we experience this unholy thing that happens when the two interact. It's not a subset, even an exclusive subset, it's an intersection.
But the following all are absolutely problems that can be talked about!
* Transphobia/Transmisia
* Antitransmasculity
* Transemasculation
* Misogyny
It sucks to be discriminated against, but the language that we use is so, so important here.

right, so, as i was saying, i dmed this very well known and very friendly seeming artist-type person and gave em the usual spiel:
- how bridge works
- how to bridge
- please do so because i want to follow you and reblog some of your stuff that i like
- if you don't want to, that's fine
and they responded "not doing that" which is all well and good but then they blocked me???
just like, for absolutely no fucking reason

not naming any names because i do NOT dislike anybody involved and i certainly do not want to incite any brigading, but this has happened with several people now, including people who have REBLOGGED AND LIKED BRIDGED POSTS FROM THIS ACCOUNT (my main), which is WHY I WANTED TO FOLLOW THEM

if they had just said "no thanks" they would have gotten an "ok, perfectly understandable! :)" or the like from me, but now everyone has to put up with my confused ranting instead. i'm not even angry, i'm just *genuinely baffled*

bsky people, is this a genuine issue over on your platform (because it's one i've almost *never* had over here on this side of the bridge) or am i just running into bad apple after bad apple

I honestly don't know what people's general feelings are about enabling the Bridgy Fed here, because that's just not a topic that ever comes up tbh (unfortunately)… But there's definitely some subset of people here who are super trigger-happy about the block button, I'm not a fan of this either.

project move out, spring break relay
day 1:
Cleared main bedroom closet
& contents of boxes on one wall.
I'm surveying all my belongings. Pulling out a small percentage to save. Sentimental items. Practical pieces for putting together a new life. At this stage I know I'm selecting more than I need, probably more than I can carry; but the amount that I'm leaving behind is far greater. Deciding what to keep & where comes after the survey. All the rest will be turned over to "scavengers."
#moverR

Day 2, midday break, Monday.
Today is harder than yesterday. I'm uncovering far more "sentimental" stuff. The challenge: these saved memories are a physical drag that impair rather than contribute anything practically to my future AND I feel integrated looking at them. There's a strong general condemnation, I feel, of holding onto sentimental items. Yet I know that they are powerful. But hey, I'm an artist. Even wistful, sad memories are valuable to me. I'm proceeding as before, retaining less+

+than I'm tossing, while knowing that I am keeping "too much." The next phase will be the actual moving & storing phase when more might be cut. This phase is the pre-screen before turning the cleared items over to others who will take everything away.
File under: how to move out of a home of 12 years & a home town of 45 years, with family roots here (& artifacts) from 150 years. I'm finally leaving, in search of a culture that suits my values.
#moverR

Falkirk strengthen top six hopes with away win at St Mirren

Miller then made sure of the points just after the hour mark as he capitalised on some static St Mirren defending to race on to his own blocked shot before dinking the ball over George.

It was an afternoon to forget for St Mirren, who lost Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips and George to injury as they slipped to a third straight defeat.

Falkirk had the first opening in the 18th minute when Barney Stewart laid the ball off to Dylan Tait, whose curling effort from just outside the box took a slight deflection before cannoning off the top of the crossbar.

St Mirren finally threatened just after the half-hour mark when Mikael Mandron shot from a tight angle, forcing Falkirk goalkeeper Scott Bain into a smart stop with his feet.

Falkirk then raced down the other end and the lively Miller was released and allowed to shoot from a similar angle but George comfortably saved.

The match was finally coming to life and Dan Nlundulu was the next to fire at goal in the 36th minute after the Bairns had given up possession cheaply, but it was a routine stop at the near post by Bain.

Nlundulu then got in behind and slid the ball home, though the cheers from the home fans were short-lived as the assistant referee raised his flag for what appeared to be a clear offside.

The hosts had already lost Donnelly to injury midway through the first half and they suffered a further blow when Phillips, who appeared to hurt his shoulder in the opening period, came off at the interval.

The match was crying out for a moment of quality and it came 10 minutes into the second half through Yeats.

Tait's perfect through ball released Miller, and although George came racing out of his goal and timed his challenge well, the loose ball fell invitingly for Yeats, who curled a stunning first-time finish into the top corner of the unguarded St Mirren goal.

It got even better for the away side just after the hour mark as the Bairns doubled their lead.

Miller's initial shot from the edge of the box was blocked by Scott Tanser but, as the home defence hesitated, Miller reacted first to run on to the loose ball and lift a right-footed shot over the onrushing George.

St Mirren suffered yet another blow shortly after as the keeper was forced off to be replaced by Ryan Mullen.

The enforced changes and the quickfire goals seemed to rock the hosts and they never threatened a comeback, with their afternoon summed up in the 89th minute when Tanser completely mis-kicked his attempted volley from six yards out.

source_doc:
Robin Roefs" penalty saves secures Sunderland's spot in FA Cup fourth round

Get the Adam Clery Football Column. A newsletter that unpacks the absurdities and oddities of the beautiful game

The ACFC newsletter: unpacking football's absurdities

Unpack football's oddities with the ACFC newsletter

Robin Roefs was Sunderland's hero as Everton's FA Cup hopes came to a premature end once again after three woeful penalties in a shootout saw the Black Cats reach round four.

David Moyes" threadbare squad looked like exiting in normal time until James Garner's 89th-minute spot-kick cancelled out Enzo Le Fee's brilliant first-half strike.

But extra time was the last thing the hosts, down to just 12 senior players, needed and when the shootout came around Garner, Thierno Barry and Beto all saw their efforts saved by Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka and Luke O'Nien confidently scored their first three attempts to help Sunderland into the fourth round for only the second time in 11 seasons.

It was a hammer blow to Everton, who were dragged back into the game by Adam Aznou, a £7.8million signing from Valladolid in the summer who had not had a sniff of first-team action.

The teenager's only senior football was two appearances in the EFL Trophy back in September and October and his 86th-minute introduction for Merlin Rohl was only because Moyes had little to no option.

But the Spanish-born Moroccan showed more drive in the four minutes of regulation time than many of his battle-weary team-mates had in the preceding 86 - particularly fellow 19-year-old and summer arrival Tyler Dibling, who cost five times as much.

Within three minutes he won an admittedly soft penalty after a shoulder-to-shoulder challenge by Trai Hume allowing Garner to equalise.

Replays of the foul on the big screens at full-time enraged Xhaka, who hurled his water bottle into the turf and raged at the perceived injustice to anyone in earshot, but the Black Cats" captain was soon celebrating.

It is rare for Sunderland, promoted from the Championship last season, to be favourites in any game but the fact Regis Le Bris was able to make five changes and still have the likes of Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete and Wilson Isidor in reserve swung the odds in their favour.

Injuries, the Africa Cup of Nations and suspensions for Michael Keane and Jack Grealish were compounded by Tim Iroegbunam's hamstring problem which took the absences to nine.

Barry, the one senior player he left out, accounted for 23 of the 27 first-team appearances among the substitutes with five of six academy players not having previously featured at all.

After Harrison Armstrong sliced wide their only first chance of the first half, Sunderland took control and should have been comfortably ahead by the interval.

Their first shot resulted in the opener - and what a goal.

Everton failed to deal with a long throw and Eliezer Mayenda teed up Le Fee to send a cushioned right-footed volley curling past Jordan Pickford.

Moyes had a face like thunder and his demeanour was not improved as Pickford clawed away a Nordi Mukiele overhead kick and tipped away, at full-stretch, Romaine Mundle's strike from distance.

Surprisingly, the Everton boss did not make the only change available to him and sacrifice one of his five midfielders for Barry at the start of the second half, but they did not come to life until Mayenda rolled an angled shot just wide with less than half an hour remaining.

Beto's appeal for a penalty for a shirt pull by Hume was waved away but referee John Brooks obliged when Aznou went down and Garner equalised.

Unfortunately for Everton their subsequent penalties were not as confident, with Barry and Beto's stuttering run-ups far from convincing, as Roefs saved all three.

Vítisvarslur Robin Roefs tryggðu Sunderland sæti í fjórðu umferð FA-bikarsins

Fáðu Adam Clery Football Column. Fréttabréf sem kryfur fáránleika og sérkenni hinnar fögru íþróttar

ACFC-fréttabréfið: fáránleiki knattspyrnunnar krufinn

Kafaðu ofan í sérkenni knattspyrnunnar með ACFC-fréttabréfinu

Robin Roefs varð hetja Sunderland þegar vonir Everton í FA-bikarnum biðu enn á ný skipbrot fyrir tímann, eftir að þrjár afleitar vítaspyrnur í vítaspyrnukeppni tryggðu Svörtu köttunum sæti í fjórðu umferð.

Fámennur hópur David Moyes virtist ætla að falla úr leik á venjulegum leiktíma þar til vítaspyrna James Garner á 89. mínútu jafnaði út glæsilegt mark Enzo Le Fee í fyrri hálfleik.

En framlenging var það síðasta sem heimamenn, sem aðeins höfðu 12 leikmenn úr aðalliðshópnum tiltæka, þurftu á að halda, og þegar kom að vítaspyrnukeppninni sáu Garner, Thierno Barry og Beto allir spyrnur sínar varðar af Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka og Luke O'Nien skoruðu af öryggi úr fyrstu þremur tilraunum sínum og hjálpuðu Sunderland í fjórðu umferð aðeins í annað sinn á síðustu 11 tímabilum.

Þetta var þungt högg fyrir Everton, sem var dregið aftur inn í leikinn af Adam Aznou, 7,8 milljóna punda sumarkaupum frá Valladolid sem hafði ekki enn fengið tækifæri með aðalliðinu.

Eina reynsla unglingsins af meistaraflokksknattspyrnu voru tvær framkomur í EFL Trophy í september og október, og innkoma hans á 86. mínútu í stað Merlin Rohl varð aðeins vegna þess að Moyes hafði nánast enga aðra valkosti.

En hinn spænskfæddi Marokkómaður sýndi meiri sóknarvilja á þessum fjórum mínútum venjulegs leiktíma en margir þreyttir liðsfélagar hans höfðu gert á undanfarandi 86 mínútum - ekki síst hinn 19 ára Tyler Dibling, sem einnig kom í sumar og kostaði fimmfalt meira.

Innan þriggja mínútna vann hann að vísu fremur linlega dæmda vítaspyrnu eftir öxl við öxl viðureign við Trai Hume og gaf Garner færi á að jafna metin.

Endursýningar af brotinu á risaskjánum við leikslok reittu Xhaka til reiði; hann kastaði vatnsbrúsa sínum í grasið og lét öllum innan eyrnarskots heyra hvað honum þótti þetta ranglátt, en fyrirliði Svörtu kattanna var skömmu síðar farinn að fagna.

Það er sjaldgæft að Sunderland, sem vann sér sæti upp úr Championship-deildinni á síðasta tímabili, sé talið sigurstranglegra í leik, en sú staðreynd að Regis Le Bris gat gert fimm breytingar og samt átt leikmenn á borð við Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete og Wilson Isidor til vara færði þeim forskotið.

Meiðsli, Afríkukeppnin og leikbönn Michael Keane og Jack Grealish bættust við aftanlærismeiðsli Tim Iroegbunam og urðu fjarverurnar þá níu talsins.

Barry, eini reynslumikli leikmaðurinn sem hann skildi utan byrjunarliðsins, átti 23 af 27 leikjum aðalliðsins meðal varamannanna, en fimm af sex akademíuleikmönnum höfðu alls ekki komið við sögu áður.

Eftir að Harrison Armstrong skaut fram hjá úr eina alvörufæri Everton í fyrri hálfleik tók Sunderland öll völd á vellinum og hefði átt að vera þægilega yfir í leikhléi.

Fyrsta skot þeirra skilaði marki - og þvílíku marki.

Everton tókst ekki að verjast löngu innkasti og Eliezer Mayenda lagði boltann fyrir Le Fee, sem sendi mjúkt hægrifótarvolley í boga fram hjá Jordan Pickford.

Moyes var svartur á svip og skap hans batnaði ekki þegar Pickford sló frá hjólhestaspyrnu Nordi Mukiele og varði síðan, á fullri teygju, langskot Romaine Mundle.

Það kom á óvart að Everton-stjórinn skyldi ekki ráðast í einu breytinguna sem raunverulega stóð honum til boða og fórna einum af fimm miðjumönnum sínum fyrir Barry í upphafi síðari hálfleiks, en liðið lifnaði ekki við fyrr en innan við hálftími var eftir þegar Mayenda renndi skoti úr þröngu færi rétt fram hjá.

Krafa Beto um vítaspyrnu vegna treyjutogs Hume var hundsuð, en dómarinn John Brooks benti á punktinn þegar Aznou féll og Garner jafnaði.

Everton til ama voru vítaspyrnur þeirra í framhaldinu mun óöruggari; hikandi aðhlaup Barry og Beto voru langt frá því að vera sannfærandi, og Roefs varði allar þrjár.

Robin Roefs varð hetja Sunderland þegar vonir Everton í FA-bikarnum biðu enn á ný skipbrot fyrir tímann, eftir að þrjár afleitar vítaspyrnur í vítaspyrnukeppni tryggðu Svörtu köttunum sæti í fjórðu umferð.

Fámennur hópur David Moyes virtist ætla að falla úr leik á venjulegum leiktíma þar til vítaspyrna James Garner á 89. mínútu jafnaði út glæsilegt mark Enzo Le Fee í fyrri hálfleik.

En framlenging var það síðasta sem heimamenn, sem aðeins höfðu 12 leikmenn úr aðalliðshópnum tiltæka, þurftu á að halda, og þegar kom að vítaspyrnukeppninni sáu Garner, Thierno Barry og Beto allir spyrnur sínar varðar af Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka og Luke O'Nien skoruðu af öryggi úr fyrstu þremur tilraunum sínum og hjálpuðu Sunderland í fjórðu umferð aðeins í annað sinn á síðustu 11 tímabilum.

Þetta var þungt högg fyrir Everton, sem var dregið aftur inn í leikinn af Adam Aznou, 7,8 milljóna punda sumarkaupum frá Valladolid sem hafði ekki enn fengið tækifæri með aðalliðinu.

Eina reynsla unglingsins af meistaraflokksknattspyrnu voru tvær framkomur í EFL Trophy í september og október, og innkoma hans á 86. mínútu í stað Merlin Rohl varð aðeins vegna þess að Moyes hafði nánast enga aðra valkosti.

En hinn spænskfæddi Marokkómaður sýndi meiri sóknarvilja á þessum fjórum mínútum venjulegs leiktíma en margir þreyttir liðsfélagar hans höfðu gert á undanfarandi 86 mínútum - ekki síst hinn 19 ára Tyler Dibling, sem einnig kom í sumar og kostaði fimmfalt meira.

Innan þriggja mínútna vann hann að vísu fremur linlega dæmda vítaspyrnu eftir öxl við öxl viðureign við Trai Hume og gaf Garner færi á að jafna metin.

Endursýningar af brotinu á risaskjánum við leikslok reittu Xhaka til reiði; hann kastaði vatnsbrúsa sínum í grasið og lét öllum innan eyrnarskots heyra hvað honum þótti þetta ranglátt, en fyrirliði Svörtu kattanna var skömmu síðar farinn að fagna.

Það er sjaldgæft að Sunderland, sem vann sér sæti upp úr Championship-deildinni á síðasta tímabili, sé talið sigurstranglegra í leik, en sú staðreynd að Regis Le Bris gat gert fimm breytingar og samt átt leikmenn á borð við Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete og Wilson Isidor til vara færði þeim forskotið.

Meiðsli, Afríkukeppnin og leikbönn Michael Keane og Jack Grealish bættust við aftanlærismeiðsli Tim Iroegbunam og urðu fjarverurnar þá níu talsins.

Barry, eini reynslumikli leikmaðurinn sem hann skildi utan byrjunarliðsins, átti 23 af 27 leikjum aðalliðsins meðal varamannanna, en fimm af sex akademíuleikmönnum höfðu alls ekki komið við sögu áður.

Eftir að Harrison Armstrong skaut fram hjá úr eina alvörufæri Everton í fyrri hálfleik tók Sunderland öll völd á vellinum og hefði átt að vera þægilega yfir í leikhléi.

Fyrsta skot þeirra skilaði marki - og þvílíku marki.

Everton tókst ekki að verjast löngu innkasti og Eliezer Mayenda lagði boltann fyrir Le Fee, sem sendi mjúkt hægrifótarvolley í boga fram hjá Jordan Pickford.

Moyes var svartur á svip og skap hans batnaði ekki þegar Pickford sló frá hjólhestaspyrnu Nordi Mukiele og varði síðan, á fullri teygju, langskot Romaine Mundle.

Það kom á óvart að Everton-stjórinn skyldi ekki ráðast í einu breytinguna sem raunverulega stóð honum til boða og fórna einum af fimm miðjumönnum sínum fyrir Barry í upphafi síðari hálfleiks, en liðið lifnaði ekki við fyrr en innan við hálftími var eftir þegar Mayenda renndi skoti úr þröngu færi rétt fram hjá.

Krafa Beto um vítaspyrnu vegna treyjutogs Hume var hundsuð, en dómarinn John Brooks benti á punktinn þegar Aznou féll og Garner jafnaði.

Everton til ama voru vítaspyrnur þeirra í framhaldinu mun óöruggari; hikandi aðhlaup Barry og Beto voru langt frá því að vera sannfærandi, og Roefs varði allar þrjár.

1. They send link for video consult, three weeks ago. It uses Ikea's proprietary videoconf solution

1/x

6. The next step in the script is "laboriously do the design from scratch over the phone with the client, hunting and pecking on the keyboard and not fast using the UI of their design software"
2/x

8. the clock has just ticked past what should have been the full consult, and they're 35% the way thru getting the required measurements.

9. So far there's been literally 8 minutes of salesdrone laboriously inputting the measurements supplied

source_doc:
The hosts took the lead in the 26th minute via the prolific Diaz as the Real Madrid player showed his scoring instinct.

Achraf Hakimi's corner was headed goalwards by Ayoub El Kaabi and Diaz deflected the ball in from close range.

He has now scored in each of Morocco's five games and extends his own record for most goals by a Moroccan at a single Cup of Nations finals, but left the field late on with a heavily strapped thigh that will be a concern for coach Walid Regragui.

Chances were hard to come by for both sides, but Abde Ezzalzouli headed narrowly over the crossbar from another Hakimi corner, while the latter laid on a headed chance for Saibari that was spurned.

Cameroon were unfortunate not to get a penalty kick when Mbeumo was caught in the box as Mauritanian referee Dahane Beida waved play on, while Georges-Kevin Nkoudou headed wide at the back post with the Indomitable Lions' best chance of the game.

Morocco made it 2-0 minutes later to kill off the contest when Saibari was left unmarked at the back post and had time to control the ball and fire low into the far corner of the net.

Ismael Saibari gave Morocco breathing space against Cameroon (REUTERS)

In Friday's other quarter-final, Iliman Ndiaye scored the only goal as Senegal booked an Afcon semi-final berth for the third time in the last four tournaments, beating 10-man Mali 1-0.

Ndiaye netted after 27 minutes, taking advantage of a goalkeeping howler to put Senegal ahead in a tense derby against their west African neighbours.

Mali were reduced to 10 men for the second half after captain Yves Bissouma was sent off for a second caution on the stroke of halftime.

He was booked first for a clumsy challenge in the 25th minute and was dismissed after a needless foul on Idrissa Gana Gueye.

Mali were down to 10 men from the 26th minute of their previous clash against Tunisia and still managed to squeeze through on penalties but there was no recovery this time around against a polished Senegalese outfit.

hypothesis:
Heimamenn komust yfir á 26. mínútu með marki hins marksækna Diaz, þegar leikmaður Real Madrid sýndi glöggt markaskyn sitt.

Hornspyrna Achrafs Hakimi var skölluð í átt að marki af Ayoub El Kaabi og Diaz stýrði boltanum í netið af stuttu færi.

Hann hefur nú skorað í öllum fimm leikjum Marokkó og bætir þar með eigið met yfir flest mörk sem Marokkómaður hefur skorað í einni lokakeppni Afríkukeppni þjóða, en fór af velli undir lok leiks með þétt reifað læri, sem hlýtur að valda þjálfaranum Walid Regragui áhyggjum.

Færi voru af skornum skammti hjá báðum liðum, en Abde Ezzalzouli skallaði naumlega yfir þverslána eftir aðra hornspyrnu frá Hakimi, sem lagði einnig upp skallafæri fyrir Saibari sem fór forgörðum.

Kamerún var óheppið að fá ekki vítaspyrnu þegar brotið var á Mbeumo innan vítateigs, en máritanski dómarinn Dahane Beida lét leikinn halda áfram. Georges-Kevin Nkoudou skallaði síðan fram hjá við fjærstöngina í besta færi Ótemjanlegu ljónanna í leiknum.

Marokkó komst í 2-0 nokkrum mínútum síðar og gerði út um leikinn þegar Saibari var óvaldaður við fjærstöngina, hafði tíma til að taka boltann niður og skjóta lágt í fjærhornið.

Ismael Saibari gaf Marokkó aukið öryggi gegn Kamerún (REUTERS)

Í hinum fjórðungsúrslitaleiknum á föstudag skoraði Iliman Ndiaye eina mark leiksins þegar Senegal tryggði sér sæti í undanúrslitum Afríkukeppni þjóða í þriðja sinn á síðustu fjórum mótum með 1-0 sigri á Malí, sem lék manni færra.

Ndiaye skoraði eftir 27 mínútur og nýtti sér afdrifarík markvarðarmistök til að koma Senegal yfir í spennuþrungnum grannaslag gegn nágrönnum þeirra í Vestur-Afríku.

Malí varð 10 manna fyrir síðari hálfleik eftir að fyrirliðinn Yves Bissouma var rekinn af velli fyrir sitt annað gula spjald rétt fyrir leikhlé.

Hann fékk fyrst gult spjald fyrir klaufalega tæklingu á 25. mínútu og var síðan rekinn af velli eftir óþarfa brot á Idrissa Gana Gueye.

Malí varð einnig 10 manna frá 26. mínútu í fyrri leik sínum gegn Túnis og tókst þá engu að síður að komast áfram eftir vítaspyrnukeppni, en að þessu sinni tókst engin endurkoma gegn vel spilandi liði Senegal.

Reading Gloria Steinem's undercover report on being a Playboy Bunny... finished Part I and damn🤔
Despite being well aware of Playboy being uh... a CORPORATION lol... had no idea how much their entire infrastructure truly served to perpetuate classism in an extremely creepy way while outwardly presenting themselves as the "classy" and thus "more ethical" option compared to say, Hustler

I'll post some screenshots later but to give you the gist, Bunnies (who were cocktail waitresses), had to:
- accept lower (by $200-150, equivalent to today's $2.5K) wages than advertised
- hand over 50% of all their tips
- give their last names to "Number 1 key holders" (ergo, celebrities/elites) if asked
- be subjected to a pelvic exam and blood test but weren't allowed to pick the physician
- be spied on by a private eye
- go out if their way to hide their husbands/bfs

The central point that unites all of this:
Bunnies were STRICTLY NOT ALLOWED TO (penalized by termination) date any other employees or customers... BUT accompanying and dating the "Number 1 key holders" was permitted, if not encouraged. See where this is going?

New recruits were given a "Bunny Bible" to study all those bizarre rules and instructions from.
To mention a few more:
- Bunnies' work performance was assessed by a "merit system" (YES, that exact wording!) instead of being written up. Unsurprisingly, merit was not only judged by a good work ethic but also very specific requirements on looks and attitude.
- there was an incentive system in place that rewarded Bunnies who sold the most liquor and merchandise

- gefa „lykilhöfum nr. 1“ (þ.e. frægu fólki/yfirstéttinni) eftirnöfnin sín ef beðið var um það

Kanínum var STRENGILEGA BANNAÐ AÐ (og þær gátu verið reknar fyrir það) deita aðra starfsmenn eða kúnna... EN það var leyfilegt, ef ekki beinlínis hvatt til þess, að fylgja „lykilhöfum nr. 1“ og deita þá. Sjáiði hvert þetta er að fara?

I'm doing a eekly 1hr meeting where I'm going over with a director of engineering my soap box on managing a product management organization and actually it's coming out to be a pretty good episodic thing

Topics have been
- different types of product managers and the basic skill sets in developing requirements
- how product managers ensure an ongoing cadence for an engineering team
- dealing with product managers with varying backgrounds (engineering, data analyst, operational SME, consulting etc)
what's been fun is that this Director and I worked at a previous company with product managers that I didn't manage and I'm able to reference "hey remember that person? that person was awesome and here's why."

so in various email chains and slack threads I'll forward them to said director (if he's already not in there) and be like "ok a GOOD product manager would do THIS" and a "BAD product maanger would do THAT" rememember when so and so did THIS? that was good.

Good Morning Worlds!
We are going to the tip this morning. It will clear some of the stuff we sorted yesterday from the drive. I don't think we can clear it all unless we took the trailer, but the trailer is full of steel for weighing in.
Later I might carry on packing tote crates.
#GoodMorningWorlds

Tip trip done, and another car load cleared out.
I have taken the new trailer axle, and trailer drive motor system, out of the scrap metal trailer load. That means we can get more scrap metal in there and also not accidentally weigh in the parts I want to keep.
I think, next, I will start moving the scrap steel from the back garden into the trailer so that it is ready to go.
Scrap steel prices are not very high at the moment but better than nothing, if I take enough of it in one go.
Still have to sort the non-ferrous scrap.

That thing when you are taking the rotten tyres off small, wide lawn tractor wheels....
Huge effort to unmount one side of the tyre, but it was really badly rusted tight on the other side of the rim.
In the time it took me to break the bead free, I'd forgotten I had already done the other side, and ended up with the rim free but completely inside the tyre!
I had to remount the tyre that side, and then work around it to get the rim out.
I had to cut up the inner tube to get that out too!
I wonder how many more tyres I need to unmount? Four done so far.

In a surprise Inspector Clouseau twist, I now have an extra thing to investigate for Spooky Kitties Sciences!
I was doing a quick scroll through the evenings secondary camera video, when I spotted a curious The Inspector standing on the trunk of the tree near the feeding station. Kept jumping around, finding him near where the magpies had been, so I initially suspect(edit) he was simply chasing them as they sometimes let him do, until I randomly chance stop...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

There Inspector Clouseau was, rolling around like crazing about 2 meters NE of the tree, mostly hidden by the unfortunate placement of the awnings east post. Still, there he was for 5 minutes, at which point he ran back up the tree, walked across the lawn to the hill, flattened himself at the bottom, and then ran off camera, presumably in the middle of The Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Now, as some of my Spooky Kitties Sciences readers may know, the motivations behind that tests are not just to entertain the kitties. While the most important aspect is the genuine curiosity I had seeing the kitties rolling around in the snow, I really wanted to find something that The Inspector liked. I came out of the initial testing with only a single moment to hint that he liked something. What that was is still a mystery.
3/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Ate a little more chicken and had a wash. Also had a little more fight when I made her take her fluids last.
We phoned the vet at 830 this morning to ask if they looked under her soft pallet while she was sedated, as she has major ear polyps. Was told the vet would call back. They didn't, rang just now (1645 local) and was told the vet wasn't in today. I was a bit annoyed and said "we paid you over £600 yesterday, you said phone if we have questions, we have questions you're not answering!"
"I don't like your tone, sir "
"It's not your fault personally, but when I pay the better part of a grand I expect a level of service that you're not providing"
"I'll get a vet from the other branch to ring you"

Seeing vet at other practise at half seven for more anti nausea medicine. They're not going to charge out of hours rate as we rang first thing.
Just got another 10ml of rescue fluids into her.

Back. Anti nausea jab, gabapentin, and she's home. Ate some chicken and some cheese.
Got more gabapentin in pill form for her, too

Won't stop eating. Having to slow her down to prevent her from vomiting. She's also absolutely, completely, totally, off her tits. Mullered. Stoned. Caned. Fully in the yellow submarine.
Vet says this'll reset her appetite, or, when we stop giving her painkillers, show it's pain stopping her eating, which would mean medical imaging time.

She's eating a bit, and even played a little, but she's still on the medications so it might be that. Still giving her recovery fluids, which she's still not fighting as she would normally.

Valencia has decided we are all Suspicious. Won't come when called, runs if you go to her. Still comes on her own terms, so it's fine, she's just seen her adoptive sister repeatedly wrapped in a towel and made to drink Stuff, and she wants none of that, thank you very much.

Ming update: she's a little more active, but still floppy and sleeping a lot. She's on two lots of painkillers still, so she's probably fairly stoned.
She IS eating, little and often, and finished off the last of her rescue fluids from a saucer by herself. She's washing, but she hasn't slapped valencia in ages, and she's still not right. Hoping it's the painkillers, and that when we withdraw them, her appetite remains.

Ming has finished the course of painkillers and is showing determined desire to go out, which we're not allowing yet. She's eating, playing, but it'll be a few days until the drugs are cleared from her system and we'll then see how she is.
Cautiously optimistic.

Borðaði aðeins meiri kjúkling og þvoði sér. Það var líka aðeins meiri mótstaða þegar ég lét hana taka vökvann sinn síðast.
Við hringdum í dýralækninn klukkan 8:30 í morgun til að spyrja hvort þau hefðu skoðað undir mjúka gómnum á henni meðan hún var svæfð, þar sem hún er með stóra separ í eyrunum. Okkur var sagt að dýralæknirinn myndi hringja til baka. Það gerðist ekki, svo við hringdum rétt í þessu (16:45 staðartíma) og þá var okkur sagt að dýralæknirinn væri ekki við í dag. Ég var dálítið pirraður og sagði „við borguðum ykkur yfir £600 í gær, þið sögðuð okkur að hringja ef við værum með spurningar, og við erum með spurningar sem þið eruð ekki að svara!“
„Mér líkar ekki tónninn í þér, herra.“
„Þetta er ekki þér persónulega að kenna, en þegar ég borga næstum heilt þúsund býst ég við þjónustu sem þið eruð ekki að veita.“
„Ég læt dýralækni frá hinni stöðinni hringja í þig.“

Förum til dýralæknis á hinni stofunni klukkan hálf átta til að fá meira ógleðislyf. Þau ætla ekki að rukka utan opnunartíma þar sem við hringdum strax í morgun.
Rétt náði að koma öðrum 10 ml af björgunarvökva ofan í hana.

Komin aftur. Sprauta við ógleði, gabapentin, og hún er komin heim. Borðaði smá kjúkling og smá ost.
Fékk líka meira gabapentin fyrir hana í töfluformi

Hún hættir ekki að borða. Þurfum að hægja á henni svo hún æli ekki. Hún er líka alveg, gjörsamlega, algjörlega, steikt. Gersamlega búin á því. Dópuð. Úti að aka. Alveg komin í gula kafbátinn.
Dýralæknirinn segir að þetta muni annaðhvort endurstilla matarlystina hennar eða, þegar við hættum að gefa henni verkjalyf, sýna að það sé sársauki sem kemur í veg fyrir að hún borði, og þá sé kominn tími á myndgreiningu.

Hún er að borða smá, og lék sér meira að segja aðeins, en hún er enn á lyfjunum svo það gæti verið ástæðan. Erum enn að gefa henni batavökvann, sem hún er enn ekki að berjast á móti eins og hún myndi venjulega gera.

Valencia hefur ákveðið að við séum öll Grunsamleg. Hún kemur ekki þegar kallað er á hana, og hleypur í burtu ef maður nálgast hana. Hún kemur samt enn til okkar á sínum eigin forsendum, svo þetta er allt í lagi, hún hefur bara séð ættleiddu systur sína aftur og aftur vafða inn í handklæði og látna drekka Dót, og hún vill ekkert með það hafa, takk fyrir pent.

Staðan á Ming: hún er aðeins virkari, en er enn slöpp og sefur mikið. Hún er enn á tvenns konar verkjalyfjum, svo hún er líklega frekar steikt.
Hún ER að borða, lítið í einu og oft, og kláraði síðasta af björgunarvökvanum sínum af undirskál alveg sjálf. Hún er að þvo sér, en hún hefur ekki löðrungað Valencia lengi, og hún er enn ekki alveg orðin góð. Vona að þetta séu verkjalyfin, og að þegar við hættum á þeim haldist matarlystin.

Ming er búin með verkjalyfjakúrinn og sýnir mjög ákveðna löngun til að fara út, sem við leyfum henni ekki enn. Hún er að borða, leika sér, en það mun taka nokkra daga þar til lyfin eru farin úr líkamanum hennar og þá sjáum við hvernig hún verður.
Varfærnislega bjartsýn.

source_doc:
And being one of the weirdo, we just frequently get attacks here and there. Either online, offline, or even from your closest people. Those attacks usually stem from homophobia, transphobia, or sometimes just, don't like how weird we are and how weird we act, especially furries that do deeper immersions like roleplaying and therianthropy.

Hence some of us got safety by not needing to tell who we are and where we were from. Some of us got safety by only revealing ourselves to our friends or close friends. Face/body reveal is a culture that most of the furries did at least once in a private post, whether it be "delete soon" kind of post or in story.

Despite being so, we're still open for social interactions offline. We do furmeets—a personal meeting between furries, be it in a group or personal, be it in an event or just casually—and sometimes making a con/fur on, such as MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, and so on. It's fun to meet them offline, get to know each other, be able to see them in person as most of us have never seen each other's faces, take a photo to keep personally and censor publicly, laugh together and discuss similar interests, and so on. It's fun, social, and warm.

Although, things don't feel the same today. As people start trying to strip anonymity of people, attack furries, therian, LGBTQIA, and dox them, as how also our community participate and stir the dramas inside, things has been a little more chaotic, less warm, and less feeling like community or family. It's not the same anymore.

Part of me hopes things can return to how it feels in the 2000s and 2010s, but, I'll just let God do the rest. I'm a little hopeless in society and humans. I'm tired of how things get worse and meant to attack and divide small communities into a hopeless being. I don't like how society is now no longer respecting and being in unity.

I wish alcohol wasn't such a normal gift in society 😅 My employer sent me a bottle of eggnog but the only alcohol we like is in alcohol markers

@doombloomart

US bound Thompson stars as Galway reach FBD final

California-bound Matthew Thompson lashed home 2-06 as Galway overcame Leitrim by 11 points in Tuam to book their spot in next week's FBD League decider.

2025 Young Footballer of the Year nominee Thompson will be out of action for the entirety of the league and the early part of the championship, with Padraic Joyce confirming that the Salthill-Knocknacarra players is studying in Berkeley for the upcoming semester.

He was the leading figure on a largely experimental Galway side - which also contained Cian Hernon and Kieran Molloy - as they came from three points down at half-time to beat Leitrim.

Thompson buried a goal in the top corner in the first half but the Connacht champions trailed Leitrim at the break, Killian Gaffney proving effective from placed balls, while Ryan O'Rourke and Jack Kelly also landed points.

Galway manager Padraic Joyce remonstrates with the referee over a decision

However, with Thompson converting a second half penalty, Galway eased home after the interval, with 10 different scorers overall as they ran out 2-19 to 0-14 winners.

After two rounds of the FBD League, the top two progress to next week's final, with Galway facing the winner of tomorrow's Roscommon-Mayo tie.

In Leinster, Westmeath have booked their spot in the O'Byrne Cup final after an 11-point win over Offaly in a goal-fest in Mullingar.

Waiting for them in the decider is a Kildare outfit that defeated Dublin 1-22 to 1-13.

Mark McHugh's Westmeath side advanced ahead of reigning champions Longford following a coin toss last Saturday but they impressed on the field of play on Saturday.

A brace of goals apiece from Danny McCarton and Brandon Kelly, plus another from Senan Baker, saw them run out 5-10 to 2-08 winners.

Ciaran Murphy scored two goals either side of half-time to pull the visitors back into the contest, the margin being briefly reduced to three points 11 minutes into the second half.

However, an unanswered burst of 3-02 over the next 15 minutes saw the hosts settle the contest in an emphatic manner.

Kildare found their feet in the second half against Dublin and now are one game away from a first O'Byrne Cup since 2014.

Harry O'Neill fires to the net for Kildare

Both management teams experimented in Newbridge with Dublin in particular shorn of overly familiar faces, but in the first half it seemed to matter little as they led 1-08 to 0-08 at the break.

Jamie McCarville palmed home their goal but it was Clyde Burke who caught the eye for the travelling support with some brilliant shooting that included two orange flags - the second of which was of the highest quality.

Alex Beirne was racking up the scores for the Lilywhites though and his two-point free early in the second half kick-started a run of 1-05 without reply, Harry O'Neill with the goal in the 43rd minute.

Kildare continued to turn the screw with James Harris' late two-pointer sending them on their way.

hypothesis:
Thompson, á leið til Bandaríkjanna, skaraði fram úr þegar Galway komst í úrslit FBD

Matthew Thompson, sem er á leið til Kaliforníu, skoraði 2-06 þegar Galway sigraði Leitrim með 11 stiga mun í Tuam og tryggði sér sæti í úrslitaleik FBD-deildarinnar í næstu viku.

Thompson, sem er tilnefndur til verðlauna sem ungi knattspyrnumaður ársins 2025, verður frá keppni út allt deildarkeppnistímabilið og fram yfir upphaf meistaramótsins, en Padraic Joyce staðfesti að leikmaður Salthill-Knocknacarra stundi nám í Berkeley á komandi önn.

Hann var lykilmaður í Galway-liði sem var að mestu skipað tilraunakenndum hópi - og þar voru einnig Cian Hernon og Kieran Molloy - þegar liðið sneri við þriggja stiga halla í hálfleik og lagði Leitrim að velli.

Thompson skoraði glæsilegt mark upp í samskeytin í fyrri hálfleik, en Connacht-meistararnir voru þó undir gegn Leitrim í leikhléi; Killian Gaffney nýtti föst leikatriði vel, auk þess sem Ryan O'Rourke og Jack Kelly komu einnig á blað.

Padraic Joyce, knattspyrnustjóri Galway, mótmælir dómara vegna ákvörðunar

Þegar Thompson skoraði síðan úr vítaspyrnu í síðari hálfleik sigldi Galway örugglega heim sigrinum eftir hléið, og með 10 mismunandi skorara vann liðið að lokum 2-19 gegn 0-14.

Eftir tvær umferðir í FBD-deildinni fara tvö efstu liðin í úrslitaleikinn í næstu viku, þar sem Galway mætir sigurvegaranum úr leik Roscommon og Mayo á morgun.

Í Leinster hefur Westmeath tryggt sér sæti í úrslitum O'Byrne-bikarsins eftir 11 stiga sigur á Offaly í markasýningu í Mullingar.

Þar bíður þeirra lið Kildare sem hafði betur gegn Dublin, 1-22 gegn 1-13.

Lið Westmeath undir stjórn Marks McHugh komst áfram á kostnað ríkjandi meistara Longford eftir hlutkesti síðasta laugardag, en liðið lét svo verkin tala á vellinum á laugardag.

Tvö mörk hvor frá Danny McCarton og Brandon Kelly, auk eins marks frá Senan Baker, tryggðu þeim öruggan sigur, 5-10 gegn 2-08.

Ciaran Murphy skoraði tvö mörk sitt hvorum megin við hálfleik og færði gestina aftur inn í leikinn, en munurinn minnkaði um stund niður í þrjú stig 11 mínútum eftir hlé.

Ósvaraður kafli upp á 3-02 á næstu 15 mínútum gerði þó út um leikinn með afgerandi hætti fyrir heimamenn.

Kildare náði betri tökum á leiknum í síðari hálfleik gegn Dublin og er nú aðeins einum sigri frá fyrsta O'Byrne-bikarnum síðan 2014.

Harry O'Neill skorar fyrir Kildare

Bæði þjálfarateymin prófuðu ýmislegt í Newbridge, og sérstaklega var lið Dublin án margra kunnuglegra andlita, en í fyrri hálfleik virtist það litlu skipta þar sem þeir leiddu 1-08 gegn 0-08 í leikhléi.

Jamie McCarville potaði inn marki þeirra, en það var Clyde Burke sem vakti hvað mesta athygli hjá stuðningsmönnum gestanna með glæsilegum skotum, þar á meðal tveimur tveggja stiga skorum - hið síðara sérstaklega glæsilegt.

Alex Beirne hélt þó uppi stigaskoruninni fyrir Lilywhites, og tveggja stiga aukaspyrna hans snemma í síðari hálfleik hratt af stað kafla upp á 1-05 án svars, þar sem Harry O'Neill skoraði markið á 43. mínútu.

Kildare hélt áfram að herða tökin og tveggja stiga skor frá James Harris seint í leiknum innsiglaði sigurinn.

Jamie McCarville potaði inn marki þeirra, en það var Clyde Burke sem vakti hvað mesta athygli hjá stuðningsmönnum gestanna með glæsilegum skotum, þar á meðal tveimur tveggja stiga skorum - hið síðara sérstaklega glæsilegt.

Alex Beirne hélt þó uppi stigaskoruninni fyrir Lilywhites, og tveggja stiga aukaspyrna hans snemma í síðari hálfleik hratt af stað kafla upp á 1-05 án svars, þar sem Harry O'Neill skoraði markið á 43. mínútu.

Kildare hélt áfram að herða tökin og tveggja stiga skor frá James Harris seint í leiknum innsiglaði sigurinn.

Relentless Clan power past Steelers in statement home win

The Clan got off to a strong start with Joe Hazeldine slamming a first-time shot into the Sheffield net after some nice slip passing between Hugo Roy and Deven Sideroff.

Despite some strong defensive play from Glasgow, the Steelers found a breakthrough via Brien Diffley's sharp shooting through traffic before Mikko Juusola gave the visitors the lead with a deflected shot from right wing.

In the second period, the Clan saw momentum swing their way with Steven Seigo slipping a tidy finish from close-range past Matthew Greenfield to tie the game up.

Shortly after, Rylan Schwartz grabbed a go-ahead goal with a bullet from the backdoor after some luck with the Clan avoiding a too many men call.

Sheffield forced their way back into the game with Ryan Tait driving on net and backhanding a shot which Brine saved but didn't keep hold of as Kevin Tansey poked a third goal over the line for the visitors.

With the score line tied going into the final frame, the noise peaked inside Braehead and Glasgow gained control of the game.

Tristin Langan saw retribution for the ongoing battle he had to put up with throughout the game with Mitchell Heard as he cracked the bar with a beautiful finish to give his side the lead.

A holding penalty on Miihkali Teppo applied pressure to the hosts' advantage late on with the Steelers pulling their netminder for the extra attacker.

Langan grabbed his second of the game on the empty net though to round off the night with a well-earned and much-needed two points for the Clan on home ice.

Glasgow Clan head coach, Corey Neilson said after the game: "We were the better team. Our forecheck was excellent, that's something we've worked on all week and it was relentless tonight. The identity we were looking for is starting to show. It was really enjoyable to coach with full lines and take advantage of a team that's playing short, because usually we're on the other side of that."

Sheffield Steelers head coach, Aaron Fox, said: "I thought we were pretty good for the majority of the game. Glasgow jumped on us early, but our bounce back was good. Our guys were gassed by the end, we only had three lines but we were in the battle all game, I can't fault the compete level of our guys."

Arthur Okonkwo's penalty shootout heroics causes FA Cup shock as Wrexham beat Nottingham Forest

Wrexham won an FA Cup third-round thriller in front of Hollywood owner Ryan Reynolds as Nottingham Forest were dumped out of the competition on penalties after a 3-3 draw.

Arthur Okonkwo was the Wrexham hero with stops from Igor Jesus and Omari Hutchinson giving them a 4-3 victory on spot-kicks after Josh Windass, Callum Doyle, George Thomason and Jay Rodriguez had converted from the spot.

First-half goals from Liberato Cacace and Oliver Rathbone gave Wrexham early control and had Reynolds trading high fives and hugs from his vantage point in the main stand.

Jesus cut the deficit before Dominic Hyam's diving header restored Wrexham's two-goal advantage with 16 minutes remaining.

Forest looked dead and buried but substitute Callum Hudson-Odoi produced two outstanding finishes, the equaliser coming in the 89th minute.

Wrexham have won three successive promotions to go from non-league to the Championship, but this was the first time since being taken over by Reynolds and fellow actor Rob Mac nearly five years ago they had met Premier League opposition.

Forest made eight changes after beating West Ham on Tuesday, with goalkeeper Matz Sels, Jesus and Hutchinson remaining and Wales international Neco Williams on a stacked bench at his local club.

Callum Hudson-Odoi came off the bench and scored twice to force the match to penalties (REUTERS)

Kieffer Moore was not risked after injury as Wrexham sought to extend a four-game winning streak that had taken them a point from the Championship play-off places.

Forest started on the front front with Jesus shooting over and Douglas Luiz found the net after 17 minutes.

Referee Paul Tierney initially awarded the goal, but then ruled it out after deciding Luiz had controlled the ball with his arm before volleying home.

Wrexham had been tidy in possession without a cutting edge but that was to change in the final 10 minutes of the first half.

Ollie Rathbone doubled Wrexham's lead after Liberato Cacace's opener (REUTERS)

Sam Smith dragged wide before Cacace took advantage after 37 minutes to drive home his maiden Wrexham goal from 20 yards aided by the faintest of deflections off Morato's heel.

Wrexham smiles were even wider three minutes later as Rathbone broke through Morato's challenge to fire in his third goal in four games.

It should have been three - and possibly contest over - when Smith scampered through the Forest half unchecked but failed to beat Sels" outstretched leg.

Forest boss Sean Dyche made a triple substitution at half-time with Williams, Morgan Gibbs-White and Nicolas Dominguez sent on to salvage the situation.

Okonkwo saved the decisive penalty to deny Omari Hutchinson in the shootout (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

The visitors were instantly more fluid as Okonkwo tipped over Luiz's free-kick and kept out Nicolo Savona's strike.

Sels saved well from Broadhead but Forest were in the ascendancy and struck when Savona set up the leaping Jesus for a header that hit the post and just about crossed the line.

The drama rose as Hyam headed in a superb George Dobson free-kick and Hudson-Odoi swept home 60 seconds later to set up a grandstand finish.

Hudson-Odoi took the tie into extra time in fantastic fashion, taking a touch on his chest and lofting a perfect volley over Okonkwo, but Wrexham were not to be denied their first top-flight FA Cup scalp for 26 years.

Sean Dyche made eight changes to the Forest side and called on his first choice players but couldn't get over the line (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

Elsewhere in the FA Cup, Oxford United advanced to the fourth round with a 4-3 penalty shootout win over MK Dons and Port Vale defeated Fleetwood 1-0.

Wigan Athletic also progressed after a superb display at Deepdale saw the League One side beat Championship play-off chasers Preston North End 1-0 as well.

Hetjuleg tilþrif Arthurs Okonkwo í vítaspyrnukeppninni urðu til þess að Wrexham sló Nottingham Forest óvænt út úr enska bikarnum

Wrexham vann æsispennandi leik í þriðju umferð enska bikarsins fyrir augum Hollywood-eigandans Ryan Reynolds, en Nottingham Forest féll úr keppni í vítaspyrnukeppni eftir 3-3 jafntefli.

Arthur Okonkwo var hetja Wrexham þegar hann varði frá Igor Jesus og Omari Hutchinson og tryggði liðinu 4-3 sigur í vítaspyrnukeppninni, eftir að Josh Windass, Callum Doyle, George Thomason og Jay Rodriguez höfðu allir skorað af punktinum.

Mörk frá Liberato Cacace og Oliver Rathbone í fyrri hálfleik færðu Wrexham snemma undirtökin og urðu til þess að Reynolds skiptist á lófataki og faðmlögum úr sæti sínu í aðalstúkunni.

Jesus minnkaði muninn áður en Dominic Hyam endurheimti tveggja marka forskot Wrexham með dýfingarskalla þegar 16 mínútur voru eftir.

Forest virtist úr leik en varamaðurinn Callum Hudson-Odoi skoraði tvö glæsileg mörk, þar á meðal jöfnunarmarkið á 89. mínútu.

Wrexham hefur farið úr utandeildum upp í Championship með þremur deildahækkunum í röð, en þetta var í fyrsta sinn síðan Reynolds og leikarinn Rob McElhenney tóku félagið yfir fyrir nærri fimm árum sem liðið mætti andstæðingi úr ensku úrvalsdeildinni.

Forest gerði átta breytingar eftir sigurinn á West Ham á þriðjudag; markvörðurinn Matz Sels, Jesus og Hutchinson héldu sæti sínu, en velski landsliðsmaðurinn Neco Williams sat á sterkum varamannabekk hjá sínu uppeldisfélagi.

Callum Hudson-Odoi kom inn af bekknum og skoraði tvívegis til að knýja fram vítaspyrnukeppni (REUTERS)

Ekki var tekin áhætta með Kieffer Moore eftir meiðsli þar sem Wrexham reyndi að lengja sigurgöngu sína í fjóra leiki, en sú hrina hafði fært liðið upp í eins stigs fjarlægð frá umspilssætum í Championship.

Forest byrjaði betur, þar sem Jesus skaut yfir og Douglas Luiz kom boltanum í netið eftir 17 mínútur.

Dómarinn Paul Tierney dæmdi markið upphaflega gilt, en ógilti það síðan eftir að hafa komist að þeirri niðurstöðu að Luiz hefði tekið boltann niður með handleggnum áður en hann skoraði með voleyskoti.

Wrexham hafði verið snyrtilegt í sinni boltameðferð án þess þó að vera nægilega beitt fram á við, en það átti eftir að breytast á síðustu tíu mínútum fyrri hálfleiks.

Ollie Rathbone tvöfaldaði forskot Wrexham eftir opnunarmark Liberato Cacace (REUTERS)

Sam Smith skaut framhjá áður en Cacace nýtti sér tækifærið á 37. mínútu og skoraði sitt fyrsta mark fyrir Wrexham með föstu skoti af um 20 metra færi, sem breytti örlítið um stefnu af hæl Morato.

"An utterly miserable day": Kempton Park meeting marred by death of three horses

The Lanzarote Hurdle card at Kempton Park was marred by the death of three horses, including the Grade One-winning Kalif Du Berlais, whose loss Paul Nicholls described as "a big kick in the teeth" and a "sad day."

Kalif Du Berlais - whose ownership group includes Sir Alex Ferguson - unseated Harry Cobden in the four-runner Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase and landed lame, with the broken shoulder he sustained proving untreatable and he was euthanised by the veterinary team on Saturday.

Nicholls said: "It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone, the owners, the poor girl who looks after him - you hate to see that happen. He was just showing his class today, he jumped and travelled well and sadly now he will never be able to show the potential we thought he had.

"I can say as much as I like, but it's just a shame for the whole team. Harry was extremely upset and is missing his ride in the last as he doesn't feel great about it. He's a big, bold horse who attacks his fences and those horses, when they do that, can end up having a bad fall.

"He was enthusiastic today and travelling beautifully and we'll never know where we would have ended up, we've always had a lot of faith in him. These things happen, sadly, and we'll have to try to pick ourselves up and move forward. These horses get the best of everything, there's not much you can say to make it better at this point.

"It never gets any easier when these things happen and it's a big old blow."

In the Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase, Jonjo and AJ O'Neill's Peso was pulled up on the flat with an injury that could not be treated, leaving racecourse vets with no choice but to euthanise him.

Harry Derham saddled Wertpol for the juvenile hurdle and the horse looked to be running a huge race before falling at the last and sustaining a life-ending injury. Derham said on his X account: "An utterly miserable day at Kempton Park today losing Wertpol who we only had the good fortune of having in our yard for a short period of time.

"It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone," said Paul Nicholls. Photograph: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"He was a bright talent who was fresh and happy doing his work every day, often playing around and expressing himself. He loved his job and I am so sad for his Heart Of The South syndicate, who are the most wonderful group of people. Racing can at times be a painful sport and today has been a tough day for a number of connections. A day to forget."

A spokesperson for Kempton Park said: "All of us at Kempton Park care deeply about the welfare of all racehorses, as do the thousands of racing staff who provide them with world-class levels of care at home every day. Our heartfelt condolences are with the connections of all three horses."

„Algjörlega ömurlegur dagur“: Keppnisdagur á Kempton Park skyggðist af dauða þriggja hesta

Kappreiðadagskrá Lanzarote Hurdle á Kempton Park skyggðist af dauða þriggja hesta, þar á meðal Kalif Du Berlais, sem hafði unnið keppni í fyrsta flokki, en Paul Nicholls lýsti missi hans sem „þungu áfalli“ og sagði daginn „sorglegan“.

Kalif Du Berlais – sem er í eigu hóps þar sem Sir Alex Ferguson er meðal eigenda – missti Harry Cobden af baki í Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase, þar sem fjórir hestar voru til keppni, og kom niður haltur. Axlarbrotið sem hann hlaut reyndist óviðráðanlegt og því var hann aflífaður af dýralæknateyminu á laugardag.

Nicholls sagði: „Það er sorglegur dagur þegar maður missir svona hesta, þetta er erfitt fyrir allt teymið. Þetta er þungt áfall fyrir alla, eigendurna, stúlkuna sem annast hann – maður vill aldrei sjá svona gerast. Hann var einmitt að sýna gæði sín í dag, stökk vel og fór vel, og því miður mun hann nú aldrei fá tækifæri til að sýna þann möguleika sem við töldum að hann byggi yfir.

„Ég get sagt hvað sem er, en þetta er einfaldlega sárt fyrir allt teymið. Harry var afar miður sín og sleppir síðasta reiðtúrnum þar sem honum líður illa vegna þessa. Hann er stór og djarfur hestur sem sækir fast á hindranirnar, og slíkir hestar geta lent í slæmu falli.

„Hann var ákafur í dag og fór einstaklega vel, og við munum aldrei vita hvar við hefðum endað. Við höfum alltaf haft mikla trú á honum. Svona gerist því miður, og við verðum að reyna að rífa okkur upp og halda áfram. Þessir hestar fá allt það besta, og það er fátt sem hægt er að segja til að gera þetta bærilegra á þessari stundu.

„Þetta verður aldrei auðveldara þegar svona gerist, og þetta er gríðarlegt áfall.“

Í Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase var Peso, hestur þeirra Jonjo og AJ O'Neill, stöðvaður á slétta kaflanum vegna meiðsla sem ekki var unnt að meðhöndla, og því áttu dýralæknar kappreiðabrautarinnar engra annarra kosta völ en að aflífa hann.

Harry Derham tefldi Wertpol fram í hindrunarhlaupi fyrir ung hross, og hesturinn virtist vera að hlaupa frábært hlaup áður en hann féll á síðustu hindrun og hlaut banvæn meiðsli. Derham sagði á X-aðgangi sínum: „Algjörlega ömurlegur dagur á Kempton Park í dag, þar sem við misstum Wertpol, sem við höfðum aðeins notið þeirrar gæfu að hafa í hesthúsinu okkar um skamma hríð.

„Það er sorglegur dagur þegar maður missir svona hesta, þetta er erfitt fyrir allt teymið. Þetta er þungt áfall fyrir alla,“ sagði Paul Nicholls. Ljósmynd: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

„Hann var afar efnilegur hestur, ferskur og glaður í vinnunni á hverjum degi, oft í leik og lét persónuleika sinn njóta sín. Hann elskaði starfið sitt og ég er afar sorgmæddur fyrir Heart Of The South-samsteypuna hans, sem er dásamlegasti hópur fólks. Kappreiðar geta stundum verið sársaukafull íþrótt og dagurinn í dag hefur verið erfiður fyrir marga sem tengjast þessu. Dagur sem best er að gleyma.“

Talsmaður Kempton Park sagði: „Við hjá Kempton Park berum djúpa umhyggju fyrir velferð allra kappreiðahesta, rétt eins og þau þúsundir starfsmanna í greininni sem veita þeim daglega umönnun á heimsmælikvarða heima fyrir. Okkar innilegustu samúðarkveðjur eru hjá aðstandendum allra þriggja hestanna.“

Melbourne Renegades host Glenn Maxwell and the Melbourne Stars at Marvel Stadium in BBL15 after Usman Khawaja and Brisbane Heat host Sydney Thunder

Sam Harper dominated with 82 not out off 51 balls and Glenn Maxwell recalled the feeling of ball on bat in a subdued innings of 20 not out off 17 balls, which included one massive six. He has not lost his ability and would have enjoyed the chance to spend time in the middle.

The crowd of 42,846 was not given the contest they hoped for as the Stars won the match by eight wickets with 25 balls remaining.

It keeps Melbourne Stars in contention as they break a three-match losing sequence and makes life hard for Melbourne Renegades. Marcus Stoinis bowled well to take 3-33 and was on a hat-trick at one stage while Harper is in great form having hit 356 runs at a strike rate of 159 for the tournament. He was man-of-the-match.

Tom Rogers bounced back with a fast 50 against Melbourne Renegades

But it was all over once Tom Rogers helped himself to 50 off 19 balls to start the innings with an opening partnership of 84 with Harper.

"They outplayed us at the "G so it was nice to get our fifth win," Harper told Fox Cricket.

Most interesting were the comments from the Fox Cricket commentary box where former England captain Michael Vaughan made it clear how disappointed he was with the way the English hierarchy handled a nightclub incident involving Harry Brook in New Zealand before they arrived in Australia for The Ashes.

Melbourne Stars veteran Peter Siddle said "it was a good turnaround" with the win pushing the team back into second spot on the BBL table.

It's starting to heat up with three games remaining for Melbourne Renegades and two matches for Melbourne Stars.

There is still plenty of cricket left this summer so keep tuning in. Thanks for following. Can the Stars finally win the title?

This morning while walking to work I had a thought: is it possible that the reason why the perception of the #replyGuy problem being worse on #Mastodon (and the #Fediverse in general) is due to sheer (lack of) numbers?
So I came up with a simplified model to check if this was indeed sufficient to explain the phenomenon.
Let's assume that, similarly to Mario Cipolla's Basic Laws of Human Stupidity, the fraction of reply guys in a population is a given constant ρ.
1/n
#maths

Let's also assume for simplicity that reply guys operate mechanically, i.e. do not use some kind of automation to find posts to reply to. This puts an upper limit to the total number of posts a reply guy can reply to in the course of a single day. Let's call this D.
We can also assume that on average a single non-reply-guy will generally post P < D posts per day.
Ignoring for a moment larger timeframes than a single day (but the discussion is similar if we extend the observation period) …
2/n

 … and assuming replyguys select randomly the posts to reply to (i.e. they don't specifically target a person for any particular reason), can we calculate what is the probability that a given person will see at least one reply from a reply guy?
Before doing the actual math, let's look at some practical example. Let's say that 1 in 10 users are reply guys, a reply guy goes through 100 posts per day, and a regular user posts 10 messages per day.
3/n

If there are 10 users in the network, 9 are regular users and 1 is a reply guy. There are 90 regular posts per day, and the the single reply guy will see ALL of them (because they can read 100 posts per day, so they see all the posts made on that network on that day.
However, if there are 100 users in the network, 10 of which are reply guys, the network will produce 900 posts in a day, but reply guys will NOT necessarily see all of them!
4/n

In the second scenario, each reply guy will see 100 random posts of the 900. Even if there are 10 reply guys, this does NOT mean that each post will be found by a reply guy! There may be posts that are seen by multiple reply guys, and posts that will not be seen by any reply guy!
So how do we compute the probability for a post to be seen by a reply guy in this case?
One way to do this is to compute the probability of NOT being seen by ANY reply guy, and taking the complement.
5/n

Now, since each reply guy sees 100 of the 900 posts, each post has a 1/9 probability of being seen by any particular reply guy, i.e. an 8/9 probability of NOT being seen by that particular reply guy. The probability of not being seen by ANY reply guy is thus 8/9 for each reply guy and assuming that the probabilities are independent, this means that the probability of not being seen by any of the 10 reply guys is (8/9)^10, which is 0.30794....
6/n

This means that the probability for each post to be seen by AT LEAST ONE reply guy is 1-(8/9)^10 or approximately 69%.
Of course, if someone posts 10 posts per day, then the probability for them to come across a reply guy is higher than that, because it will be the probability of at least on their post being seen by at least one reply guy!
Again assuming that for each post the probabilities are independent, the math is only slightly more complex:
6/n

each post has a (8/9)^10 probability of not being seen, but for the probability for ALL posts not being seen, that has to be further elevated to the number of posts made by the same person, which is 10, so (8/9)^100, and the probability of AT LEAST ONE POST being seen by AT LEAST ONE reply guys becomes 1 - (8/9)^100 = 0.99999233… which is not 100% but very close to it.
This was the case of a network 100 people, 10 of which are reply guys. Let's do one more and then go general.
7/n

Let's now assume the network has 100K users, still with the same 10% of reply guys (90K regular users, 10K reply guys).
Each reply guy still reads 100 posts per day, and the regular users still produce 10 posts per day.
This means that in a single day the regular users produce 900K posts, and each reply guys reads 100 of those 900K posts!
Still under the randomness assumption, this means that a single reply guy will only see 100/900K posts!
8/n

Í morgun, á leiðinni í vinnuna, datt mér í hug: gæti verið að ástæðan fyrir því að #svarakallavandinn virðist verri á #Mastodon (og í #Fediverse almennt) sé einfaldlega fólgin í hreinum fjölda — eða réttara sagt skorti á honum?
Þá setti ég saman einfaldað líkan til að athuga hvort það eitt og sér dygði til að útskýra þetta fyrirbæri.
Gefum okkur að, svipað og í Basic Laws of Human Stupidity hjá Mario Cipolla, sé hlutfall svarakalla í þýði fasti, ρ.
1/n
#stærðfræði

Gefum okkur líka, til einföldunar, að svarakallar hegði sér vélrænt, þ.e. noti ekki neins konar sjálfvirkni til að finna færslur til að svara. Það setur efri mörk á heildarfjölda færslna sem svarakall getur svarað á einum degi. Köllum það D.
Við getum líka gert ráð fyrir að venjulegur notandi, sem er ekki svarakall, birti að meðaltali P < D færslur á dag.
Ef við lítum í bili fram hjá lengri tímabilum en einum degi (þótt umræðan sé svipuð ef við lengjum athugunartímann) …
2/n

… og gefum okkur að svarakallar velji af handahófi hvaða færslum þeir svara (þ.e. þeir beinlínis eltist ekki við ákveðna manneskju af einhverri sérstakri ástæðu), getum við þá reiknað líkurnar á því að tiltekinn einstaklingur sjái að minnsta kosti eitt svar frá svarakalli?
Áður en við förum í sjálfa stærðfræðina skulum við taka einfalt hagnýtt dæmi. Segjum að 1 af hverjum 10 notendum sé svarakall, að hver svarakall fari yfir 100 færslur á dag og að venjulegur notandi birti 10 skilaboð á dag.
3/n

Ef það eru 10 notendur á netinu eru 9 venjulegir notendur og 1 svarakall. Þá verða til 90 venjulegar færslur á dag, og þessi eini svarakall sér ÞÆR ALLAR (því hann getur lesið 100 færslur á dag, svo hann sér allar færslurnar sem verða til á því neti þann daginn).
En ef það eru 100 notendur á netinu, þar af 10 svarakallar, þá verða til 900 færslur á einum degi, en svarakallarnir munu EKKI endilega sjá þær allar!
4/n

Í seinni sviðsmyndinni sér hver svarakall 100 handahófskenndar færslur af þessum 900. Þótt það séu 10 svarakallar þýðir það EKKI að hver einasta færsla finnist af svarakalli! Sumar færslur gætu sést af mörgum svaraköllum, og aðrar gætu farið fram hjá þeim öllum!
Svo hvernig reiknum við líkurnar á því að færsla sjáist af svarakalli í þessu tilviki?
Ein leið til þess er að reikna líkurnar á því að hún sjáist EKKI af NEINUM svarakalli, og taka svo andstæðuna við það.
5/n

Núna, þar sem hver svarakall sér 100 af 900 færslum, hefur hver færsla 1/9 líkur á að sjást af tilteknum svarakalli, þ.e. 8/9 líkur á að sjást EKKI af þeim tiltekna svarakalli. Líkurnar á að sjást ekki af NEINUM svarakalli eru því 8/9 fyrir hvern svarakall og ef við gefum okkur að líkurnar séu óháðar, þýðir það að líkurnar á að sjást ekki af neinum af þessum 10 svaraköllum eru (8/9)^10, sem er 0.30794....
6/n

Þetta þýðir að líkurnar á að hver færsla sjáist af AÐ MINNSTA KOSTI EINUM svarakalli eru 1-(8/9)^10, eða um það bil 69%.
Auðvitað, ef einhver birtir 10 færslur á dag, þá eru líkurnar á að viðkomandi rekist á svarakall meiri en það, því þá erum við að tala um líkurnar á að að minnsta kosti ein af færslunum þeirra sjáist af að minnsta kosti einum svarakalli!
Aftur, ef við gefum okkur að líkurnar séu óháðar fyrir hverja færslu, verður stærðfræðin bara aðeins flóknari:
6/n

hver færsla hefur (8/9)^10 líkur á að sjást ekki, en til að fá líkurnar á að ALLAR færslurnar sjáist ekki þarf svo að hækka það í veldi sem samsvarar fjölda færslna frá sama einstaklingi, sem er 10, þannig að það verður (8/9)^100, og líkurnar á að AÐ MINNSTA KOSTI EIN FÆRSLA sjáist af AÐ MINNSTA KOSTI EINUM svarakalli verða þá 1 - (8/9)^100 = 0.99999233… sem er ekki 100% en rosalega nálægt því.

@kagan Just use anything, even the cashier receipts from your grocery shopping - whatever you want. A friend of mine who exhibits a lot put a sheet of toilet roll from every place he's exhibiting in his scrapbook another friend got injured while hanging her frames and eventually used the cast from the injury and some gouache to stamp patters on the pages. Hence: everything's involved you want involved.

@aurora And then you... take all these things, and glue, staple, or otherwise attach them into a book? Is that it?
I'm unclear on what happens next, or why.
Honestly, I may just not be a scrapbooking person.

@kagan Yes, that's exactly the way to go! Intentionally spill your coffee, drop an ink cartridge... whatever suits you. One just needs to get all these fancy ideas shown on pinterest or whatever out of one's head. It's about documenting the process instead of being a visual dainty. Use it like a wrecking journal if that suits. It's totally up to the person who makes it.

I just had a very nice #dream that I made friends with Lee Chaeyeon. I just started talking to her nand the next thing I know, I have stayed over her house (like when the French kidnapped me for Christmas) and she is telling me to go up stairs and "shuffle up a little bit" (her English was generally excellent) by which she meant "tidy up a little bit" to show her mom we were ready to eat.
She comes upstairs to "shuffle up" her room and starts making gestures to explain what she means ...
1/

(she was always so excited to see me in this dream) because I was taking my coat off instead of "shuffling up."
Then she indicates this little piece of paper and says she has left me an autograph but in return she wants this little trading card I made in second grade of "50 Spikes," a sonic knock-off, obviously with more spikes. (This card actually exists IRL BTW). I start explaining to her what it is and if she really wants it (she did) I at least needed a picture of her holding it.
2/

Partly because I would miss it, but also, otherwise no one would believe me that she had wanted this thing from me.
It was then I realized we still didn't have each others' phone numbers.
3/3

source_doc:
@JugglingWithEggs at least in my friend circle mobile phones not uncommon from early 90s, but they cost a *lot* to call from a landline (so if you were living at home your parents would discourage it), and until 1995-1999 were insecure, anyone with a radio scanner could (and often did) listen to them.
Whilst radio scanners were out of the price range of youths, many older folk had them, and until late 90s were often the kind of radio enthusiast who was a Tory bootlicker and supported the Police and other Establishment organisations, so you if discussing anything subversive on a mobile phone you risked being grassed up..
Ironically the tide turned by late 90s when scanners became affordable, and the Police were still on analogue radios 😁

@JugglingWithEggs by late 1990s everyone had a mobile phone and calls were cheaper (often with a good amount of free minutes) but SMS messages were unreliable and initially didn't even work across networks - people actually talked to each other on them!
One difference was access to physical spaces wasn't as heavily controlled as today - even though there was still CCTV and locals would call old bill on youths "hanging around", there was neither sufficient boots on the ground nor interconnected CCTV (a real security guard had to watch the footage locally, and property owners generally didn't want to pay for these folk at evenings and weekends.
There were also fewer cops on duty in outer suburbs during nights/weekends - they were all deployed into the town centres)

@vfrmedia
I remember texts sometimes taking hours to come through in the early noughties - so not always great for making on the fly arrangements.
Living in market town definitely meant less cctv and coppers back in 90’s. Remember difference when heading out into Bournemouth or Norwich of an evening. But young people having fun wasn’t frowned upon like it is now. My earlier post about facial recognition was about area where there has been uptick in teens just hanging out.

Ironing the lightweight green corduroy for my first try at the Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern. I don't know how I feel about the recommendation to use interfacing but it probably does want something to stiffen and thicken it a bit.
#millinery

Sachi's newsboy cap pattern advises to cut the crown pieces diagonal to the weave ("on the bias") to allow more stretch around the circumference but that will make the corduroy rows run aslant, where I prefer them vertical.
We shall see. This is the test cookie to get a feel for the pattern. I like corduroy for texture but green wouldn't be my first choice, and this fabric is lightweight enough that I should add a layer, whether interfacing or what-have-you from the stash.

On a second look, my fabric isn't corduroy at all, it's just velvet, so I can cut at 45° to the fabric weave like Sachi suggests in the Newsboy Cap pattern and it won't look strange.
#millinery

But you.

In a regular limo?

You run into a lot of those, huh?
Yeah.
Even my grandmother sends me demo tapes.
So what were you afraid was weird?

source_doc:
Local stable out to cash in at Coffs with four contenders

Local trainer Noel Mayfield-Smith is hoping to have a lucrative day at Sunday's Coffs Harbour meeting with four runners stepping out for the stable on the six-race card.

The Group 1-winning horseman will start his day in the second event of the day when Ausbred Yahoo contests the Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap (1605m) with two-kilogram claiming apprentice Ella Drew taking the ride.

Racing returns to Coffs Harbour on Sunday.

Ausbred Yahoo has been racing in good form with a third placing at Kempsey three starts ago being followed by two successive seconds at Coffs Harbour, the latest when beaten by Sunday's rival Caledonian.

Mayfield-Smith links with another apprentice, three-kilogram claimer Leanne Boyd, when Never Island starts in the Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

A winner of three of her 15 starts, Never Island will carry 59.5 kilograms after Boyd's allowance. Never Island was beaten less than a length when second behind Montgomery at Grafton and backed that up with a last-start fifth at Coffs Harbour behind In The Fine Print when again beaten less than a length.

Raymond Spokes takes the ride on the Mayfield-Smith-prepared Monte Cruise in the O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap (1205m).

Monte Cruise is also a three-time winner from just the nine starts. She hasn't raced since July when finishing last of eight at Eagle Farm and has had two trials at this track in preparation for her return, finishing second behind Saturday's Wyong winner Petticoat before winning the latest of them.

Mayfield-Smith rounds out the day when he again links with Boyd when she rides Cardsharp in the Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

The amp is a Philips FA454 and the CD Player is a Philips CD150.
According to the amp manual I can connect the units with a "8-pole DIN to 5-pole DIN + 2 x single-pole CINCH" cable."
I take this to mean an 8 pin din to a 5 pin + stereo RCA cable...which sounds cursed.
Never been able to find one. Can anyone make one?

The service manual for the amp is nice and clear (picture 2 in above toot), but I can't find anything as nice for the CD player. I've attached a picture (picture 4 in the above toot) from the service manual that I *think* is the relevant section.
Currently I have the CD player hooked up with just the RCA cables and it all works fine, but if I could find/make the correct Din to Din + RCA cable then I could use some additional functionality and free up the only RCA stereo inputs on my amp.

There's a repair café this weekend in the town where I live...if I'm still puzzling over it all by then I might take it all along there and see if they can help me hack together a cable.

source_doc:
On a lighter note, just saw someone complaining about when games beg you to switch to easy mode when you fail.
I also hate this.
I love having an easy mode. Hell, I think games should just fuckin' let you cheat, as long as competitions all have agreed-on rules about it.
But every game that's pestered me into easy mode has been an instant put-down. I have plenty of games to play, if you want me to be done faster, congrats, I'm done faster.

This is what makes modern Marios - modern-ish anyway - so impossible for me to play.
"Did you die thwee times mawwio? Here's the golden supersuit of invincibility because you suck! If you don't want it, just carefully avoid ever pressing anything besides "start level yes again no no nothing else just start the level".
This is also why I stopped trying to play Phantom Pain. Whenever I died, it'd offer me the chicken hat and default to "yes", eventually I forgot to manually say "fuck off".

I get it's a retention thing, but it's so disrespectful.
Autoscaling difficulty also pisses me off, because I'll be gearing up for a challenge and then the game will panic and lower it to super easy because I've been "struggling".
I'll die or something, go back to try again, but nope, now the challenge is gone. You succeeded! You made the game go away! Don't worry, those challenges were for someone else. Someone better.
I can't remember if I ever completed a game with autoscaling difficulty.

I guess the basic difference between me and their target audience is that I like to figure out how to do something, while their target audience - at least in their heads - likes to take a log flume through a Disneyworld attraction.
A little jostling, a little fluids, but don't worry, baby, daddy Walt's got ya. You're safey-wafe, you don't even have to move, just sit there and tee hee, here's a wittle splashy-splash.
If I wanted that, I'd go sit in a fucking dog park and pet a dog.
